title: carpesium nepalense var. pedunculosa
intro: Carpesium nepalense var. pedunculosa, commonly known as the Himalayan wormwood, is a variant of the Carpesium nepalense plant species, which is traditionally used in Ayurvedic and Unani medicine. The plant is known for its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antimicrobial properties, which have been used to treat various ailments such as fever, skin conditions, and respiratory infections. The therapeutic actions of Carpesium nepalense var. pedunculosa include its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve pain and inflammation, and promote wound healing, making it a valuable herbal remedy in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of the plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a valuable resource for the development of new pharmaceuticals.
